response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, Spring ecosystem, or enterprise IDE development — key requirements for the role. Their background is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only incidental Java exposure in early roles without evidence of deep JVM or IDE internals expertise.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across languages and platforms
Proven track record in open-source tooling and developer education
Extensive experience with CI/CD, testing, and dev-ops infrastructure
concerns: No evidence of professional work on JVM-based IDEs or language tooling
Minimal to no recent Java/Kotlin or Spring framework experience
Focus on web/Node.js/DLang contradicts core technical requirements
